name: yala-delivery
description: Yala Delivery - Courier packages across Mauritania

scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item ../frontend/.env.delivery ../frontend/.env.local -Force; Push-Location ../frontend; npm run build; Pop-Location; Remove-Item ./www -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ./www -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item ../frontend/build/* ./www -Recurse -Force; node ../frontend/scripts/stamp-native-app-type.js delivery ./www"
scripts.build:local: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item ../frontend/.env.delivery.localtest ../frontend/.env.local -Force; Push-Location ../frontend; npm run build; Pop-Location; Remove-Item ./www -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ./www -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item ../frontend/build/* ./www -Recurse -Force; node ../frontend/scripts/stamp-native-app-type.js delivery ./www"
